description: List EBOPS 2010 service trade categories — the equivalent of comtrade_search_commodities for the services domain. Returns category codes, descriptions, and parent codes. Filter by keyword to find a specific service type (e.g. "transport", "financial", "travel"), or browse from a parent category code. Use the returned id as service_code in comtrade_get_services_trade.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

parent_code.description: Return only sub-categories of this parent EBOPS code. Example: "SA" to see all transport service sub-categories.

query.description: Keyword or category code prefix to filter results. Examples: "transport", "SA", "financial services". Omit to list all EBOPS categories.

name: comtrade_list_service_categories

categories.description: EBOPS 2010 service categories matching the query.

id.description: EBOPS category code (use as service_code in trade queries).

parent.description: Parent EBOPS category code, if any.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no results found or results are truncated.

totalMatches.description: Total matching categories before limit truncation.

truncated.description: True when categories were capped at the limit (totalMatches exceeds shown).

title: List Service Trade Categories (EBOPS)
